subject.title: [Bug] Session 数据丢失：对话中断后未持久化

question: For Feishu reconnects after local disconnect or gateway/session interruption, should OpenClaw guarantee replay/backfill into the existing logical session, make dedupe/session recording atomic enough to avoid lost retries, or preserve current delivery semantics but send a visible interruption notice?
rationale: Current source shows ordinary received events are recorded, but the desired behavior for redelivery, dedupe timing, rebuilt session identity, and user-visible recovery is a product/transport contract choice rather than a single proven mechanical fix.

options.title: Define Feishu recovery contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask Feishu-capable maintainers to choose and live-test replay, dedupe atomicity, session continuity, or interruption-notice behavior.

options.title: Fold into broad restart recovery
options.body: Treat this as Feishu evidence for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425 while preserving the original missing-message details as linked context.

options.title: Split to narrower Feishu repairs
options.body: Move session-key rebuild evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87938 and provider-context-loss evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76665, keeping only reconnect/dedupe loss here.

recommendation.title: Define Feishu recovery contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask Feishu-capable maintainers to choose and live-test replay, dedupe atomicity, session continuity, or interruption-notice behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history signal on the Feishu dedupe/session path and are already tied to adjacent restart-recovery follow-up.
